title: CarInsureRec
summary: A research repository for insurance product recommendation experiments, combining missingness injection/imputation methods and a contrastive-learning recommender (MICLRec) evaluated across three insurance datasets. Its data preprocessing scripts import SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and Metadata classes from sdv.single_table/sdv.metadata to synthesize insurance data, though the actual fit/save call is left commented out.
evidence: data/VID/data_preproce.py:5 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer'; line 39 '# synthesizer.fit(df_sdv)' is commented out
needs: The CTGANSynthesizer fit/save call is commented out in all three data_preproce.py files, so it's unclear whether SDV was actually run to produce the parquet datasets or only prepared and abandoned.
